title: Patient Management
overview: This guide covers patient management workflows for Provider.

subtasks.title: Patient Management menu (sidebar)
subtasks.purpose: Expose the Patient Management flyout with Add New Patient plus three lookup entry points.

steps.title: Open Patient Mgmt Menu
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt in the left sidebar to open the flyout.

steps.title: Choose Add or Lookup
steps.description: Pick Add New Patient to enrol, or one of the three Lookup options to search.

steps.title: Close the Flyout
steps.description: Click outside the flyout (or on another sidebar entry) to close it. Notes The red dot on Patient Mgmt indicates an unread items badge (missed uploads, abnormal readings or care-plan items pending review).

subtasks.title: Add New Patient — Step 1: Demographics
subtasks.purpose: Capture the patient’s personal information, account credentials, care-team assignments and communication preferences.

steps.title: Open Add New Patient
steps.description: From the Patient Mgmt flyout click Add New Patient — the “Let’s enroll the patient” modal opens on Step 1 (Demographics).

steps.title: Pick a Title
steps.description: Under Personal Information, pick a Title (Mr / Mrs / Ms / Dr / -).

steps.title: Enter Patient Name
steps.description: Enter First Name * (e.g., John), Middle Name (e.g., Marie) and Last Name * (e.g., Doe).

steps.title: Pick Gender & Birth Date
steps.description: Pick Gender * (Male / Female / Other) and enter Date Of Birth * (mm/dd/yyyy).

steps.title: Enter SSN
steps.description: Enter SSN * in the 000-00-0000 mask.

steps.title: Enter Phone Numbers
steps.description: Enter Home Phone *, Cell Phone * and optionally Fax in (000) 000 - 0000 format.

steps.title: Set Username & Password
steps.description: Scroll to Account Credentials — the platform proposes a username; adjust if required, and set a temporary password (the patient is prompted to change it on first login).

steps.title: Enter Home Address
steps.description: Scroll to Address — Street, City, State, ZIP.

steps.title: Assign Provider & Caregivers
steps.description: Under Care Team & Settings pick the Provider (defaults to self) and one or more Caregivers who will monitor the patient.

steps.title: Set Language & Time Zone
steps.description: Set the Preferred Language and Time Zone so reminders arrive at the correct local time.

steps.title: Toggle Notification Preferences
steps.description: Toggle SMS / Email notification preferences.

steps.title: Advance to Programs Step
steps.description: Click Next to advance to Step 2 (Programs), or Cancel to discard. Notes SSN is stored encrypted at rest; only the last four digits are shown in the UI after save. The three-step wizard progress bar at the top (Demographics · Programs · RPM) is clickable — but Next must be used at least once to unlock each step. First Name / Last Name / Gender / DOB / SSN / Home Phone / Cell Phone are required — Next stays disabled until all are valid.

subtasks.title: Add New Patient — Step 2: Programs
subtasks.purpose: Enrol the patient into CCM, RPM or both, choose chronic conditions and set the care-plan cadence.

steps.title: Toggle CCM Enrollment
steps.description: On Step 2, toggle CCM to enrol the patient in Chronic Care Management.

steps.title: Pick Chronic Conditions
steps.description: If CCM is toggled on, pick two or more Chronic Conditions from the list (e.g., Diabetes, Hypertension, COPD) — a minimum of two is required for 99490 billing.

steps.title: Choose Care Plan Type
steps.description: Choose the Care Plan Type (Standard / Complex) and the review cadence.

steps.title: Toggle RPM Enrollment
steps.description: Toggle RPM to enrol the patient in Remote Patient Monitoring.

steps.title: Pick Vitals to Monitor
steps.description: If RPM is toggled on, pick the vitals to monitor (BP, Blood Glucose, Weight) — each ticked vital shows a chip on the Patients grid.

steps.title: Advance or Save Patient
steps.description: Click Next to move to Step 3 (RPM setup) when RPM is enabled, or Save to finish if only CCM is enabled.

steps.title: Return to Demographics Step
steps.description: Use Back to return to Step 1 to correct demographics. Notes At least one program (CCM or RPM) must be enabled to proceed. Chronic Conditions can be added / removed later from the patient profile without unenrolling. RPM vital selection determines the target sets applied — BP uses Systolic / Diastolic / Pulse targets, Glucose uses Fasting / Post-meal targets, Weight uses the Weight / BMI targets configured on the Schedule & Targets tab.

subtasks.title: Add New Patient — Step 3: RPM (meter mapping & insurance)
subtasks.purpose: Bind the patient’s cellular meter(s) to their record and capture the insurance details required for RPM billing.

steps.title: Choose Meter Model
steps.description: On Step 3, choose the Meter Model per selected vital (BP cuff, Glucometer, Scale).

steps.title: Enter Meter Serial Number
steps.description: Enter the Meter Serial Number (16 characters) — the field validates length and uniqueness.

steps.title: Enter Model Number
steps.description: Enter the Model # exactly as printed on the device.

steps.title: Set RPM Start Date
steps.description: Set the RPM Start Date — this drives the billing window and the CPT 99453 setup claim.

steps.title: Enter Insurance Details
steps.description: Enter primary Insurance — Carrier, Member ID, Group, Plan Type — and optional secondary insurance.

steps.title: Capture Patient Consent
steps.description: Capture the Patient Consent method (Verbal / Written) and consent date.

steps.title: Save the Patient
steps.description: Click Save to finish the wizard — the modal closes and the new patient appears in the Patients grid.

steps.title: Return to Programs Step
steps.description: Use Back to return to Step 2 to change program selections. Notes A serial that is already bound to another patient is rejected — the meter must be unassigned first. RPM Start Date sets the beginning of the current 30-day billing window; the Practice tab Program Dates table reflects it immediately. For dual-program patients, CCM enrolment date is captured separately on Step 2 — the two programs bill on independent cycles.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (general search)
subtasks.purpose: Find a patient across the practice using name, program, provider, caregiver and status filters.

steps.title: Open Lookup Patient
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient.

steps.title: Enter Name Filters
steps.description: Enter Last Name and / or First Name filters (partial match is supported).

steps.title: Pick Program Enrolled
steps.description: Pick Program Enrolled * (required — CCM / RPM / Both).

steps.title: Scope by Provider
steps.description: Optionally pick a Provider from the dropdown to scope to a single provider’s panel.

steps.title: Scope by Caregiver
steps.description: Optionally pick a Caregiver to scope to a single caregiver’s panel.

steps.title: Pick Status Filter
steps.description: Pick Status (Active / Paused / Lost) or leave -- Select -- for all.

steps.title: Run or Reset Query
steps.description: Click Query to run the search, or Reset to clear all filters.

steps.title: Keyword-Filter Results
steps.description: Use the Search box (top-right) to keyword-filter within the loaded result set.

steps.title: Open Patient Dashboard
steps.description: Click a patient row to open the patient dashboard. Notes Program Enrolled is the only required filter — Query stays disabled until it is chosen. The empty state “Select filters and click Query to load patients” is displayed until Query is clicked.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by RPM date)
subtasks.purpose: Report on RPM patients for a specified service-date window with meter identifiers, upload activity, service time and eligible CPT codes.

steps.title: Open RPM Lookup
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by RPM date).

steps.title: Pick RPM Date Range
steps.description: Under RPM Service Date Range, pick the start date (mm/dd/yyyy) and the end date (mm/dd/yyyy).

steps.title: Run or Reset Report
steps.description: Click Query to run the report; click Reset to clear the range.

steps.title: Keyword-Filter Results
steps.description: Use the Search box to keyword-filter the loaded rows.

steps.title: Sort RPM Results
steps.description: Sort by RPM Start Date (or any header) using the column arrow.

steps.title: Print, Export, or Email
steps.description: Click Print to open the print dialog, Export to download CSV / Excel, or Email to send the report to a recipient. Notes Measurement Days = distinct upload days in the window — the field driving 99454 eligibility (≥ 16 days required).

steps.title: Eligible CPT Codes is a live calculation
steps.description: 99453 (setup), 99454 (device supply, needs ≥ 16 measurement days), 99457 (first 20 min), 99458 (each additional 20 min). A dash (-) in Model # / Serial # means the meter binding is not yet complete — fix on the patient profile before billing.

subtasks.title: Lookup Patient (by CCM date)
subtasks.purpose: Report on CCM patients for a specified service-date window with chronic conditions, enrolment date, last activity, service time, eligible CPT codes and billing state.

steps.title: Open CCM Lookup
steps.description: Click Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by CCM date).

steps.title: Pick CCM Date Range
steps.description: Pick the CCM Service Date Range — start and end.

steps.title: Run or Reset Query
steps.description: Click Query; use Reset to clear.

steps.title: Keyword-Filter Results
steps.description: Use the Search box to keyword-filter the loaded rows.

steps.title: Sort CCM Results
steps.description: Sort by Enrollment Date (or any header) using the column arrow.

steps.title: Distribute the Report
steps.description: Click Print, Export or Email to distribute the report. Notes Billing = Pending means the CCM cycle for that patient has not yet been submitted; Billed means the claim is filed. Eligible CPT Codes reflects 99490 (first 20 min), 99439 (each additional 20 min) and 99491 (physician-provided CCM) based on Service Time and provider type. Chronic Conditions must be ≥ 2 for a patient to appear as billable for 99490. Task 8.4 — Care Management
